summary: Design-only economy and cap policy draft for converting Affinity gifts (AF2-A catalog) into Affinity points and tier progression. NO live stat buffs, NO DB writes, NO endpoints, NO UI buttons. Borea gifts are locked. Adult/explicit naming is forbidden. Paid-only mandatory progression is forbidden. All values labeled 'placeholder' or 'future' MUST be re-ratified before any runtime activation.

gift_value_tiers.description: Universal low-tier gift accepted by all heroes; lowest affection-point yield.
Faction-favored gift (matches hero faction only); medium-low yield.
Element-favored gift (matches hero element only); medium-low yield.
Dual-axis favored gift (matches BOTH hero faction AND hero element); medium-high yield. Generated via 12x7 matrix in AF2-A draft.
Reserved for future event-limited cosmetic/aesthetic gifts. MUST NOT confer competitive advantage; cosmetics only or capped same as faction_element_favored.

future_activation_prerequisites: DB schema design + non-destructive migration for affinity_points and hero_affinity tier records.
Inventory source schema + anti-dup / anti-spend exploit validation.
Auth-gated gift spend endpoint (POST /api/affinity/gift-spend) with idempotency keys + server-side validation; not created in AF2-B.
Anti-abuse validation: daily/weekly caps, diminishing returns curve ratified.
UI gift confirm flow with explicit user consent; no auto-spend.
Cap policy ratification: PvP caps <=2 per source / <=6 total, non-multiplicative initial.
Borea unlock gate respected: greek_borea gift records remain hidden / catalog-only until Borea visibility unlocks. Legacy borea / primordial_gaia excluded permanently.
Cross-system audit with Collection Synergy V2 + Divine Weapons to prevent stack abuse (see STACK-A).
Rollback plan: ability to disable AFFINITY_GIFT_RUNTIME_ENABLED and revert tier progression without data loss.
Economy balancing test pass on staging before runtime ON.
recommended_next_tasks: AF2-C (hypothetical): Gift inventory schema draft + anti-exploit invariants.
AF2-D (hypothetical): Cross-system stack audit Collection Synergy V2 x Affinity Phase 2 x DW.
AF2-E (hypothetical): UI read-only preview screen for affinity tiers (no spend button).
